field_verifications.proposed_value: CD4+ and CD8+ T-cell intracellular IFNγ, IL2 and TNFα after stimulation; acquired on a flow cytometer
field_verifications.evidence_text: PBMC were washed and 1 × 10 6 cells were stimulated with 20 μg/ml of PPD, 2 μg/ml of each 85A peptide in a pool of 66 peptides, 5 μg/ml staphylococcal enterotoxin (Sigma) or left unstimulated as negative control. Cells were then washed, permeabilised using Cytofix/Cytoperm kit (BD Pharmingen) following the manufacturer's recommendations and stained intracellularly for 30 min in the cold with a mix of: CD3/AF700, IFNγ/PECy7 (eBioscience), CD8/APC-AF750, IL2/PE (Beckman Coulter) and TNFα/AF647 (clones UCHT1, 4S.B3, B9.11, N7.48A, MAB11 and BL168 respectively). Stained cells were immediately acquired using an LSR-II (Becton Dickinson). Only live CD3+ cells were included in the analysis of CD4+ and CD8+ cell cytokine responses.
field_verifications.reason: The text explicitly describes stimulated PBMC stained for intracellular IFNγ, IL2, and TNFα and analyzed for CD4+ and CD8+ cytokine responses by flow cytometric acquisition.
